verdict.rationale: The skills' source is publicly readable in the anthropics/skills GitHub repo, including raw SKILL.md files and a template. Community members cite reading the xlsx skill and adapting the repo into a model-agnostic version, and Anthropic has published Agent Skills as an open standard. However, nothing in the evidence states which license covers the repository. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the repo, and confirmation that all skills (including the bundled document skills) are released under that license.
